package.trip_title: Historic Highlights of Jerash and Ajloun

trip_description.overview: Explore the ancient Roman city of Jerash, the lush forests of Ajloun, and savor authentic Jordanian cuisine in a relaxed, culturally rich itinerary.
included: Daily lunch and dinner at local restaurants

daily_itinerary.day_summary: Morning exploration of the Roman city, lunch at a local café, afternoon visit to the Roman theater, and dinner at a traditional Jordanian restaurant. Overnight at a 3-star hotel in Jerash.

activities.description: Walk through the colonnaded streets, the Temple of Artemis, and the impressive Oval Plaza.
activities.smart_tip: Wear comfortable shoes and bring sunscreen.

activities.description: Enjoy local Jordanian dishes such as mansaf and falafel.
Explore the well-preserved theater and learn about its historical significance.
Savor traditional Jordanian cuisine in a cozy setting.
activities.smart_tip: Ask for the chef's special of the day.

activity_alternatives.reason: If you prefer indoor activities or want more context on the ruins.

daily_itinerary.day_summary: Morning hike in Ajloun Forest, lunch at a local eatery, afternoon visit to Ajloun Castle, and dinner at a nearby restaurant. Overnight at a 3-star hotel in Ajloun.

activities.description: Trail through pine forests with scenic views.
activities.smart_tip: Carry water and wear sturdy shoes.

activities.description: Taste local Jordanian dishes in a rustic setting.
Explore the medieval fortress and its panoramic views.
activities.smart_tip: Bring a camera for sunset shots.

activities.description: Enjoy traditional Jordanian meals with a view of the forest.
activities.smart_tip: Reserve a table early for the best view.

activity_alternatives.reason: If you prefer a cultural site with less walking.

daily_itinerary.day_summary: Morning visit to the Jordan Museum, lunch at a local café, afternoon free time for shopping or relaxation, and dinner at a renowned Amman restaurant. Overnight at a 3-star hotel in Amman.

activities.description: Explore artifacts from the region's history.
Sample local Jordanian cuisine in a modern setting.
Shopping in downtown Amman or relaxation at a café.
Enjoy a fine dining experience with traditional Jordanian dishes.
activities.smart_tip: Reserve a table for the best view of the city.

activity_alternatives.reason: If you prefer a structured cultural visit.
